arguments.command:
D=/data/current.db; sqlite3 -header -column $D "
WITH att AS (SELECT operation_id, COUNT(*) natt FROM attempt_events GROUP BY 1),
fin AS (SELECT operation_id, MAX(attempt_no) mx FROM attempt_events GROUP BY 1),
ops AS (SELECT lo.operation_id, att.natt, CASE WHEN lo.opened_at_ms<1778151600000 THEN 'ref' ELSE 'inc' END period,
 (SELECT ra.pool_id FROM route_assignments ra WHERE ra.route_id=lo.route_id AND ra.effective_from_ms<=lo.opened_at_ms AND ra.effective_to_ms>lo.opened_at_ms) pool_id,
 (SELECT pp.deadline_ms FROM route_assignments ra JOIN policy_profiles pp ON pp.profile_id=ra.profile_id WHERE ra.route_id=lo.route_id AND ra.effective_from_ms<=lo.opened_at_ms AND ra.effective_to_ms>lo.opened_at_ms) dl
 FROM logical_operations lo JOIN service_routes sr ON sr.route_id=lo.route_id AND sr.service_id=2 JOIN att ON att.operation_id=lo.operation_id
 WHERE lo.opened_at_ms>=1778148000000 AND lo.opened_at_ms<1778155200000)
SELECT o.period, w.pool_code, COUNT(*) ops, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tf,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),4) tfpct,
 SUM(o.natt) att, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fa,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/SUM(o.natt),4) afpct,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.natt>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) retr, MIN(o.dl) mindl, MAX(o.dl) maxdl,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN a.queue_ms END),3) qfail,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN a.execution_ms END),3) efail
FROM ops o JOIN worker_pools w ON w.pool_id=o.pool_id JOIN attempt_events a ON a.operation_id=o.operation_id JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=a.code_id JOIN fin f ON f.operation_id=o.operation_id
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;"

    "SELECT ra.route_id, ra.effective_from_ms, ra.effective_to_ms, ra.pool_id, ra.profile_id, p.deadline_ms FROM route_assignments ra JOIN policy_profiles p ON p.profile_id=ra.profile_id WHERE ra.route_id IN (3,4,8) ORDER BY ra.route_id, ra.effective_from_ms;"
  ]
